summary: omp subagents stay listed while waiting for a person, and late turn events do not start new runs

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged. Claim kinds and fields are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: omp subagents report while their live session stays busy, including foreground asks and tool approvals. Each heartbeat clears cached waits without live busy evidence, even if a resolution event was lost. A late turn event after the end no longer starts a run. IDs longer than 256 UTF-8 bytes are rejected, and names longer than 128 UTF-8 bytes are omitted. The extension changes take effect after the harness restarts.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover. Existing claims are unchanged.
